integrity: The finite exhaustive enumeration uses all downsets for maximal-element extension, exact directed graph isomorphism for deduplication, and integer-exact inclusion counts. A separate direct checker verifies both witness lattices.
scientific_limitations: Exhaustiveness is limited to nontrivial distributive lattices with at most eight join-irreducibles.
The exact finite enumeration has been replayed and direct witness checked; no independent human audit was performed.
The one-round profile collision is not a collision under full two-variable counting logic; the witnesses separate at round two.
An earlier specialised statement outside the inspected literature may exist.
title: The unique eight-generator one-round refinement collision in finite distributive lattices
